result: There are faint ochre marks after the last clearly read tempus est. A concordance-exposed ut is only a candidate; the marks have not been established as writing. The E40 description of an absolute visible endpoint should be read as the last clearly transcribed word.
finnish_comparison: The IV.156 catalogue reports a range ff.9–11 beginning ut laborum; the physical Finnish page and the mark's function remain unexamined.
interpretation: The marks cannot yet support or disprove an immediate text continuation; different layers, cue, offset or damage remain live alternatives.
